roles.description: Grants read/write access to Kubernetes resources within a namespace in the fleet-managed hub cluster - provides write permissions on most objects within a namespace, with the exception of ResourceQuota object and the namespace object itself. Applying this role at cluster scope will give access across all namespaces.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Admin for Member Clusters
roles.description: This role grants admin access - provides write permissions on most objects within a namespace, with the exception of ResourceQuota object and the namespace object itself. Applying this role at cluster scope will give access across all namespaces.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Cluster Admin
roles.description: Grants read/write access to all Kubernetes resources in the fleet-managed hub cluster.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Cluster Admin for Member Clusters
roles.description: Lets you manage all resources in the member clusters in the fleet.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Reader
roles.description: Grants read-only access to most Kubernetes resources within a namespace in the fleet-managed hub cluster. It does not allow viewing roles or role bindings. This role does not allow viewing Secrets, since reading the contents of Secrets enables access to ServiceAccount credentials in the namespace, which would allow API access as any ServiceAccount in the namespace (a form of privilege escalation). Applying this role at cluster scope will give access across all namespaces.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Reader for Member Clusters
roles.description: Allows read-only access to see most objects in a namespace. It does not allow viewing roles or role bindings. This role does not allow viewing Secrets, since reading the contents of Secrets enables access to ServiceAccount credentials in the namespace, which would allow API access as any ServiceAccount in the namespace (a form of privilege escalation).  Applying this role at cluster scope will give access across all namespaces.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Writer
roles.description: Grants read/write access to most Kubernetes resources within a namespace in the fleet-managed hub cluster. This role does not allow viewing or modifying roles or role bindings. However, this role allows accessing Secrets as any ServiceAccount in the namespace, so it can be used to gain the API access levels of any ServiceAccount in the namespace.  Applying this role at cluster scope will give access across all namespaces.

roles.name: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager RBAC Writer for Member Clusters
roles.description: Allows read/write access to most objects in a namespace. This role does not allow viewing or modifying roles or role bindings. However, this role allows accessing Secrets and running Pods as any ServiceAccount in the namespace, so it can be used to gain the API access levels of any ServiceAccount in the namespace.  Applying this role at cluster scope will give access across all namespaces.

roles.description: View permissions for Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Can view recommendations, alerts, a security policy, and security states, but cannot make changes. For Microsoft Defender for IoT, see Azure user roles for OT and Enterprise IoT monitoring.

roles.name: Chaos Studio Experiment Contributor
roles.description: Can create, run, and see details for experiments, onboard targets, and manage capabilities.

roles.name: Chaos Studio Operator
roles.description: Can run and see details for experiments but cannot create experiments or manage targets and capabilities.

roles.name: Chaos Studio Reader
roles.description: Can view targets, capabilities, experiments, and experiment details.

roles.name: Chaos Studio Target Contributor
roles.description: Can onboard targets and manage capabilities but cannot create, run, or see details for experiments

roles.name: Deployment Environments Reader
roles.description: Provides read access to environment resources.

roles.name: Deployment Environments User
roles.description: Provides access to manage environment resources.

roles.name: DevCenter Dev Box User
roles.description: Provides access to create and manage dev boxes.

roles.name: DevCenter Owner
roles.description: Provides access to manage all Microsoft.DevCenter resources, and to manage access to Microsoft.DevCenter resources by adding or removing role assignments for the DevCenter Project Admin and DevCenter Dev Box roles.

roles.name: DevCenter Project Admin
roles.description: Provides access to manage project resources.

roles.name: DevOps Infrastructure Contributor
roles.description: Read, write, delete and perform actions on Managed DevOps Pools

roles.name: DevTest Labs User
roles.description: Lets you connect, start, restart, and shutdown your virtual machines in your Azure DevTest Labs.

roles.name: Lab Assistant
roles.description: Enables you to view an existing lab, perform actions on the lab VMs and send invitations to the lab.

roles.name: Lab Contributor
roles.description: Applied at lab level, enables you to manage the lab. Applied at a resource group, enables you to create and manage labs.

roles.name: Lab Creator
roles.description: Lets you create new labs under your Azure Lab Accounts.

roles.name: Lab Operator
roles.description: Gives you limited ability to manage existing labs.

roles.name: Lab Services Contributor
roles.description: Enables you to fully control all Lab Services scenarios in the resource group.

roles.name: Lab Services Reader
roles.description: Enables you to view, but not change, all lab plans and lab resources.

roles.name: Load Test Contributor
roles.description: View, create, update, delete and execute load tests. View and list load test resources but can not make any changes.

roles.name: Load Test Owner
roles.description: Execute all operations on load test resources and load tests

roles.name: Load Test Reader
roles.description: View and list all load tests and load test resources but can not make any changes

roles.name: Playwright Workspace Contributor
roles.description: View and list Playwright Workspace resources but can not make any changes. Can manage service access tokens and execute Playwright tests.

roles.name: Playwright Workspace Owner
roles.description: Perform all operations on Playwright Workspace resources. Can manage service access tokens and execute Playwright tests.

roles.name: Playwright Workspace Reader
roles.description: View and list all Playwright Workspace resources and tests but can not make any changes.

roles.name: Azure Migrate Decide and Plan Expert
roles.description: Grants restricted access on Azure Migrate project to only perform planning operations including appliance-based discovery, managing inventory, identifying server dependencies, creation of business case & assessment reports.

roles.name: Azure Migrate Execute Expert
roles.description: Grants restricted access on an Azure Migrate project to only perform migration related operations, including replication, execution of test migrations, tracking and monitoring of migration progress, and initiation of agentless and agent-based migrations.

roles.name: Azure Migrate Owner
roles.description: Grants full access to create and manage Azure Migrate projects including appliance-based discovery, creation of business case & assessment report and execution of migrations; Also grants ability to assign Azure Migrate specific roles in Azure RBAC.

roles.name: Azure Migrate Service Reader
roles.description: Grants required access to the system assigned managed identity of Azure Migrate project resource.

roles.name: Azure Local Migrate Execute Expert
roles.description: Grants restricted access on an Azure Local based Azure Migrate project to only perform migration related operations, including replication, execution of migrations, tracking and monitoring of migration progress, and initiation of agentless migrations.

roles.name: Azure Local Migrate Owner
roles.description: Grants full access to create and manage Azure Local based Azure Migrate projects including appliance-based discovery and execution of migrations; Also grants ability to assign Azure Migrate Local specific roles in Azure RBAC

roles.name: Migrate Arc Discovery Reader - Preview
roles.description: Read metadata of Azure Arc enabled server resources and metadata, performance and migration suitability of Arc enabled SQL server resources. Users creating Azure Migrate project that uses Arc resource discovery require this role on Arc scope of the project. To enable periodic sync, Azure Migrate project managed identity must be assigned this role. This role is in preview and subject to change.

roles.name: Application Insights Component Contributor
roles.description: Can manage Application Insights components

roles.name: Application Insights Snapshot Debugger
roles.description: Gives user permission to view and download debug snapshots collected with the Application Insights Snapshot Debugger. Note that these permissions are not included in the Owner or Contributor roles. When giving users the Application Insights Snapshot Debugger role, you must grant the role directly to the user. The role is not recognized when it is added to a custom role.

roles.name: Azure Managed Grafana Workspace Contributor
roles.description: Can manage Azure Managed Grafana resources, without providing access to the workspaces themselves.

roles.name: Data Purger
roles.description: Delete private data from a Log Analytics workspace.

roles.name: Grafana Admin
roles.description: Manage server-wide settings and manage access to resources such as organizations, users, and licenses.

roles.name: Grafana Editor
roles.description: Create, edit, delete, or view dashboards; create, edit, or delete folders; and edit or view playlists.

roles.name: Grafana Limited Viewer
roles.description: View home page.

roles.name: Grafana Viewer
roles.description: View dashboards, playlists, and query data sources.

roles.name: Log Analytics Contributor
roles.description: Log Analytics Contributor can read all monitoring data and edit monitoring settings. Editing monitoring settings includes adding the VM extension to VMs; reading storage account keys to be able to configure collection of logs from Azure Storage; adding solutions; and configuring Azure diagnostics on all Azure resources.

roles.name: Log Analytics Data Reader
roles.description: Log Analytics Data Reader can query and search the logs it is allowed to view over Log Analytics workspaces and tables

roles.name: Log Analytics Reader
roles.description: Log Analytics Reader can view and search all monitoring data as well as and view monitoring settings, including viewing the configuration of Azure diagnostics on all Azure resources.

roles.name: Monitored Objects Contributor
roles.description: Grants permissions to create and link a monitored object to a user or group. For more information, see Set up the Azure Monitor Agent on Windows client devices.

roles.name: Monitoring Contributor
roles.description: Can read all monitoring data and edit monitoring settings. See also Get started with roles, permissions, and security with Azure Monitor.

roles.name: Monitoring Metrics Publisher
roles.description: Enables publishing metrics against Azure resources

roles.name: Monitoring Policy Contributor
roles.description: Allows read access to all monitoring data, update permissions for monitoring settings and permissions to deploy and remediate Azure Monitor alert policies.

roles.name: Monitoring Reader
roles.description: Can read all monitoring data (metrics, logs, etc.). See also Get started with roles, permissions, and security with Azure Monitor.

roles.name: Service Health Security Reader
roles.description: Grants permissions to view sensitive security information present in service health events

roles.name: Workbook Contributor
roles.description: Can save shared workbooks.

roles.name: Workbook Reader
roles.description: Can read workbooks.

roles.name: Advisor Recommendations Contributor (Assessments and Reviews)
roles.description: View assessment recommendations, accepted review recommendations, and manage the recommendations lifecycle (mark recommendations as completed, postponed or dismissed, in progress, or not started).

roles.name: Advisor Reviews Contributor
roles.description: View reviews for a workload and triage recommendations linked to them.

roles.name: Advisor Reviews Reader
roles.description: View reviews for a workload and recommendations linked to them.

roles.name: Automation Contributor
roles.description: Manage Azure Automation resources and other resources using Azure Automation.

roles.name: Automation Job Operator
roles.description: Create and Manage Jobs using Automation Runbooks.

roles.name: Automation Operator
roles.description: Automation Operators are able to start, stop, suspend, and resume jobs

roles.name: Automation Runbook Operator
roles.description: Read Runbook properties - to be able to create Jobs of the runbook.

roles.name: Azure Center for SAP solutions administrator
roles.description: This role provides read and write access to all capabilities of Azure Center for SAP solutions.

roles.name: Azure Center for SAP solutions reader
roles.description: This role provides read access to all capabilities of Azure Center for SAP solutions.

roles.name: Azure Center for SAP solutions service role
roles.description: Azure Center for SAP solutions service role - This role is intended to be used for providing the permissions to user assigned managed identity. Azure Center for SAP solutions will use this identity to deploy and manage SAP systems.

roles.name: Azure Connected Machine Onboarding
roles.description: Can onboard Azure Connected Machines.

roles.name: Azure Connected Machine Resource Administrator
roles.description: Can read, write, delete and re-onboard Azure Connected Machines.

roles.name: Azure Connected Machine Resource Manager
roles.description: Custom role for Azure Local resource provider (Microsoft.AzureStackHCI Resource Provider) to manage hybrid compute machines and hybrid connectivity endpoints in a resource group

roles.name: Azure Customer Lockbox Approver for Subscription
roles.description: Can approve Microsoft support requests to access specific resources contained within a subscription, or the subscription itself, when Customer Lockbox for Microsoft Azure is enabled on the tenant where the subscription resides.

roles.name: Billing Reader
roles.description: Allows read access to billing data

roles.name: Blueprint Contributor
roles.description: Can manage blueprint definitions, but not assign them.

roles.name: Blueprint Operator
roles.description: Can assign existing published blueprints, but cannot create new blueprints. Note that this only works if the assignment is done with a user-assigned managed identity.

roles.name: Carbon Optimization Reader
roles.description: Allow read access to Azure Carbon Optimization data

roles.name: Cost Management Contributor
roles.description: Can view costs and manage cost configuration (e.g. budgets, exports)

roles.name: Cost Management Reader
roles.description: Can view cost data and configuration (e.g. budgets, exports)

roles.name: Essential Machine Management Administrator
roles.description: Can managed Essential Machine Management resources for subscriptions

roles.name: Hierarchy Settings Administrator
roles.description: Allows users to edit and delete Hierarchy Settings

roles.name: Managed Application Contributor Role
roles.description: Allows for creating managed application resources.

roles.name: Managed Application Operator Role
roles.description: Lets you read and perform actions on Managed Application resources

roles.name: Managed Application Publisher Operator
roles.description: Allows the publisher to read resources in the managed resource group for Managed Application and request JIT access for additional operations. This role is only used by the Managed Application service to provide access to publishers.

roles.name: Managed Services Registration assignment Delete Role
roles.description: Managed Services Registration Assignment Delete Role allows the managing tenant users to delete the registration assignment assigned to their tenant.

roles.name: Management Group Contributor
roles.description: Management Group Contributor Role

roles.name: Management Group Reader
roles.description: Management Group Reader Role

roles.name: New Relic APM Account Contributor
roles.description: Lets you manage New Relic Application Performance Management accounts and applications, but not access to them.

roles.name: Policy Insights Data Writer (Preview)
roles.description: Allows read access to resource policies and write access to resource component policy events.

roles.name: Quota Request Operator
roles.description: Read and create quota requests, get quota request status, and create support tickets.

roles.name: Reservation Purchaser
roles.description: Lets you purchase reservations

roles.name: Reservations Reader
roles.description: Lets one read all the reservations in a tenant

roles.name: Resource Policy Contributor
roles.description: Users with rights to create/modify resource policy, create support ticket and read resources/hierarchy.

roles.name: Savings plan Purchaser
roles.description: Lets you purchase savings plans

roles.name: Scheduled Patching Contributor
roles.description: Provides access to manage maintenance configurations with maintenance scope InGuestPatch and corresponding configuration assignments

roles.name: Service Group Administrator
roles.description: Manage all aspects of service groups and relationships. The default role assigned to users when they create a service group. Includes an ABAC condition to constrain role assignments.

roles.name: Service Group Contributor
roles.description: Manage all aspects of service groups and relationships, but does not allow you to assign roles.

roles.name: Service Group Reader
roles.description: Read service groups and view the connected relationships.

roles.name: Site Recovery Contributor
roles.description: Lets you manage Site Recovery service except vault creation and role assignment

roles.name: Site Recovery Operator
roles.description: Lets you failover and failback but not perform other Site Recovery management operations

roles.name: Site Recovery Reader

roles.name: SRE Agent Administrator
roles.description: Full control of the agent—manage chats, incident response plans, and agent run modes; approve and execute commands.

roles.name: SRE Agent Reader
roles.description: Grants read-only access to all SRE Agent data, including chats, incidents, logs, and configurations. Does not permit interaction with the agent.

roles.name: SRE Agent Standard User
roles.description: Grants access to interact with the SRE Agent to triage incidents and run diagnostics.

roles.name: Support Request Contributor
roles.description: Lets you create and manage Support requests

roles.name: Tag Contributor
roles.description: Lets you manage tags on entities, without providing access to the entities themselves.

roles.name: Template Spec Contributor

roles.name: Template Spec Reader
roles.description: Allows read access to Template Specs at the assigned scope.

roles.description: Azure Arc ScVmm Private Clouds Onboarding role has permissions to provision all the required resources for onboard and deboard vmm server instances to Azure.

roles.name: Azure Arc ScVmm VM Contributor
roles.description: Arc ScVmm VM Contributor has permissions to perform all VM actions.

roles.name: Azure Resource Bridge Deployment Role

roles.name: Azure Stack HCI Connected InfraVMs
roles.description: Role of Arc Integration for Azure Stack HCI Infrastructure Virtual Machines.

roles.name: Azure Stack HCI Device Management Role
roles.description: Microsoft.AzureStackHCI Device Management Role

roles.description: Grants permissions to perform all VM actions

roles.name: Azure Stack HCI VM Reader
roles.description: Grants permissions to view VMs
